messages:
Alex: Quick sync — ACME is insisting on SSO + real-time embeddings for GA. If we keep both, we won't hit the April 14 launch. Can we re-scope today?
Maria: My take — do a phased "Core" vs "Pilot" approach. Core = text generation, chat, basic embeddings, rollout controls. Pilot = realtime embeddings, tenant-level SSO (SCIM + provisioning), extended evals. Core can hit Apr 14 if Pilot is deferred.
Jon: Sales note: ACME will push on SSO. They say realtime embeddings is a hard requirement for some of their use cases but might accept a paid early-access Pilot for it. Need sign-off from legal for pilot terms.
Carol: From eng estimation: realtime embeddings needs KV prefix caching + batching changes and 2–3 stabilization sprints. SSO (SSO + SCIM) is smaller from a feature POV but triggers security review + audit logs which can add ~1 sprint of overhead.
Siva: Ops note — Dedicated pools can handle Core traffic. Realtime embeddings increases memory and KV pressure; it'll require a small Dedicated capacity bump which impacts committed spend. Also there's an outstanding router perf regression that could add ~1 week of delay if we hit edge-case loads.
Alex: Options on the table:
- Option A: Keep Apr 14, ship Core only, offer ACME paid Pilot for SSO+realtime (early access, SLA-lite).
- Option B: Slide GA by 2 weeks to include SSO but defer realtime embeddings to Pilot.
- Option C: Delay GA to include both SSO + realtime embeddings.
I lean A (ship Core) + Pilot for ACME. Preserves launch momentum and gives ACME a commercial path.
Maria: Quick reaction poll — A 👍, B :thinking:, C 👎
Jon: Sales agrees with A; ACME prefers early access over delaying the contract. I'll start legal outreach for a pilot addendum.
Carol: I'll drop realtime embeddings from the GA cut and push SSO into sprint 1. Adding a hard gate in the PRD: "Realtime embeddings only enabled via Pilot flag; not in Core GA."
Alex: Please paste the minimal cutlist we can commit to and any cross-team blockers.
Carol: ```
Cutlist (Core GA):
- Keep: streaming chat, turn-by-turn API, basic embeddings (offline batching), rollout & canary controls
- Defer to Pilot: realtime embeddings (KV cache + prefix caching), tenant-level SCIM provisioning, long-term embedding metrics/aggregation
- Security: include SSO login flow (OAuth/SAML) for Core, defer SCIM/provisioning to Pilot
- Observability: basic token-level latency + cost. Extended embedding quality dashboards deferred
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for branch feature/realtime-embeddings failed in staging at 2024-03-20T18:12:03Z — OOM on embedding worker (repro: 8/10 requests with 2048-length inputs).
Carol: That's aligned with the perf risk; another reason to deprioritize for GA.
Alex: OK — decision: ship Core on Apr 14, offer ACME paid Pilot for realtime embeddings + SCIM. Carol, update the roadmap PRD and include cutlist. Jon, please escalate legal + sales terms. Siva, flag Dedicated capacity implications for finance. I'll notify PMs and the launch comms thread. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria: Awesome. I'll update the launch checklist and communications template.
Jon: On it — pinging legal now.
Siva: I'll run a quick capacity delta and post here by EOD.
